mapper.select: SELECT p.id ,p.pool_name ,p.pool_type FROM ip_investment_pool p WHERE p.status = 'enabled' AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.pool_type = 'crmw' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_investment_pool child WHERE child.parent_id = p.id AND child.status = 'enabled' AND child.is_deleted = 0 ) ORDER BY p.outer_sort ASC ,p.inner_sort ASC ,p.id ASC

SELECT p.id ,p.parent_id ,p.pool_code ,p.pool_name ,p.pool_type ,p.pool_level ,p.market_codes ,p.variety_codes ,p.hs_pool_name ,p.in_flow_id ,p.in_flow_key ,p.in_flow_name ,p.out_flow_id ,p.out_flow_key ,p.out_flow_name ,p.simple_in_flow_id ,p.simple_in_flow_key ,p.simple_out_flow_id ,p.simple_out_flow_key ,p.batch_in_flow_id ,p.batch_in_flow_key ,p.batch_in_flow_name ,p.batch_out_flow_id ,p.batch_out_flow_key ,p.batch_out_flow_name ,p.max_capacity ,p.lock_flag ,p.open_day_adjust ,p.status ,p.is_deleted ,p.crte_time ,p.updt_time FROM ip_investment_pool p WHERE p.id = #{poolId} AND p.status = 'enabled' AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.pool_type = 'crmw' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_investment_pool child WHERE child.parent_id = p.id AND child.status = 'enabled' AND child.is_deleted = 0 ) LIMIT 1
